en.content:
A copper wire is wound on a wooden frame, whose shape is that of an equilateral triangle. If the linear
dimension of each side of the frame is increased by a factor of 3, keeping the number of turns of the coil per
unit length of the frame the same, then the self inductance of the coil:

options.content: decreases by a factor of <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.251ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="4.192ex" height="2.398ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -949 1853 1060" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mn"><use data-c="39" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-39"></use></g><g data-mml-node="msqrt" transform="translate(500,0)"><g data-mml-node="mo" transform="translate(0,89)"><use data-c="221A" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-221A"></use></g><g transform="translate(853,0)"><g data-mml-node="mn"><use data-c="33" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-33"></use></g></g><rect width="500" height="60" x="853" y="829"></rect></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>
increases by a factor of 27
decreases by a factor of 9
increases by a factor of  3

en.explanation:
Total length L will remain constant

L = (3a) N        (N = total turns)

and length of winding = (d) N

                         (d = diameter of wire)


self inductance = 0n2A

= 0n2 dN

a2 N a

So self inductance will become 3 times

The charged particle is shifted from he origin to the point P(x = 1; y = 1) along a straight path. The magnitude of the total work done is :

options.content: 5 q

en.explanation:
2q + 3q

5q

hi.content:
एक कण जिसका द्रव्यमान m और आवेश q है, एक विद्युत और चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में है जो द्वारा दिया गया है


आवेशित कण को मूल से बिंदु P(x = 1; y = 1) तक एक सीधी पथ के साथ स्थानांतरित किया गया है। किए गए कुल कार्य की मात्रा है :

options.content: 5 q
